raw_segments.text: And so, Glauken, I said, we have at last arrived at the Hymn of Dialectic.
This is that strain which is of the intellect only, but which the faculty of sight will
nevertheless be found to imitate, for sight, as you may remember, was imagined by us after
a while to behold the real animals and stars, and last of all the sun himself.
And so with Dialectic, when a person starts on the discovery of the Absolute by the light
of reason only, and without any assistance of sense, and perseveres until by pure intelligence
he arrives at the perception of the Absolute Good, he at last finds himself at the end
of the intellectual world, as in the case of sight at the end of the visible.
